name: F4b_near_zero_length_line
sw_rationale: Family 4 (Near-degenerate). A line with p1=(0,0) fixed, p2 initially at (0.0001, 0.0002) — near-zero length. A distance constraint drives the length to exactly 0.01mm. SolidWorks handles micro-geometry gracefully (used in chamfer profiles etc.). Expected: converged=true, dof=0, line length = 0.01, no NaN. Confidence HIGH for convergence, HIGH for length. The direction is unconstrained so p2 can be anywhere on a circle of r=0.01.

expect._coord_notes: e1 must be horizontal length 0.01. p2 = (0.01, 0). No NaN/Inf.
